long_description: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.

name: Fishious Rend
short_description: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
long_description: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

name: Smokescreen
short_description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1.
long_description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

name: Surf
short_description: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.
long_description: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.

name: Dragon Cheer
short_description: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.
long_description: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

name: Focus Blast
short_description: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Land's Wrath
short_description: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Scratch
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Baby-Doll Eyes
short_description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1.
long_description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

name: Life Dew
short_description: Heals the user and its allies by 1/4 their max HP.
long_description: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

name: Corrosive Gas
short_description: Removes adjacent Pokemon's held items.
long_description: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, a Silvally, a Zacian, or a Zamazenta to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

name: Protect
short_description: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.
long_description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

name: Zing Zap
short_description: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
long_description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

name: Ice Punch
short_description: 10% chance to freeze the target.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

name: Expanding Force
short_description: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5x power, hits foes.
long_description: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

name: Foresight
short_description: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
long_description: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.

name: Helping Hand
short_description: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5x this turn.
long_description: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

name: Fusion Bolt
short_description: Power doubles if used after Fusion Flare this turn.
long_description: Power doubles if the last move used by any Pokemon this turn was Fusion Flare.

name: Court Change
short_description: Swaps user's field effects with the opposing side.
long_description: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

name: Tidy Up
short_description: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.
long_description: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

name: Quick Attack
short_description: Usually goes first.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Buzzy Buzz
short_description: 100% chance to paralyze the foe.
long_description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the foe.

name: Bullet Seed
short_description: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
long_description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

name: Natural Gift
short_description: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.
long_description: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.

name: Rock Climb
short_description: 20% chance to confuse the target.
long_description: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

name: Poison Tail
short_description: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

name: Razor Wind
short_description: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.
long_description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

name: Aqua Ring
short_description: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.
long_description: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

name: Healing Wish
short_description: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.
long_description: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

name: Charge Beam
short_description: 70% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
long_description: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

name: Doodle
short_description: User and ally's Abilities become target's Ability.
long_description: The user and its ally's Abilities change to match the target's Ability. Does not change Ability if the user's or its ally's is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target. Fails if both the user and its ally's Ability already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

name: Sunny Day
short_description: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.
long_description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.

name: Grudge
short_description: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.
long_description: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.

name: Salt Cure
short_description: Deals 1/8 max HP each turn; 1/4 on Steel, Water.
long_description: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/4 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

name: Electric Terrain
short_description: 5 turns. Grounded: +Electric power, can't sleep.
long_description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

name: Jungle Healing
short_description: User and allies: healed 1/4 max HP, status cured.
long_description: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and has its status condition cured.

name: Hone Claws
short_description: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1.
long_description: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.

name: First Impression
short_description: Nearly always goes first. First turn out only.
long_description: Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

name: Drill Run
short_description: High critical hit ratio.
long_description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

name: Spikes
short_description: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.
long_description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

name: Self-Destruct
short_description: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.
long_description: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

name: G-Max Drum Solo
short_description: Always 160 power. Ignores Abilities.
long_description: Power is 160 regardless of the base move's Max Move power. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

name: Armor Cannon
short_description: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
long_description: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Lovely Kiss
short_description: Causes the target to fall asleep.
long_description: Causes the target to fall asleep.

name: G-Max Wildfire
short_description: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Fire-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

name: Extreme Speed
short_description: Nearly always goes first.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Psyshield Bash
short_description: 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.
long_description: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Belly Drum
short_description: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.
long_description: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

name: Ice Fang
short_description: 10% chance to freeze. 10% chance to flinch.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

name: Heal Bell
short_description: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
long_description: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

name: Autotomize
short_description: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.
long_description: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.

name: Vine Whip
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Lunge
short_description: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
long_description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

name: G-Max Steelsurge
short_description: Base move affects power. Foes: Steel hazard.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Steel type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

name: Conversion 2
short_description: Changes user's type to resist target's last move.
long_description: The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used by the target, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user cannot change its type, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.

name: Grassy Terrain
short_description: 5 turns. Grounded: +Grass power, +1/16 max HP.
long_description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.

name: Max Knuckle
short_description: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Attack.
long_description: Boosts the user and its allies' Attack by 1 stage. BP scales with the base move's BP. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.

name: Tailwind
short_description: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.
long_description: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

name: Double Shock
short_description: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.
long_description: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

name: Cotton Guard
short_description: Raises the user's Defense by 3.
long_description: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

name: Slash
short_description: High critical hit ratio.
long_description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

name: Prismatic Laser
short_description: User cannot move next turn.
long_description: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

name: Stone Axe
short_description: Sets Stealth Rock on the target's side.
long_description: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

name: Milk Drink
short_description: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
long_description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

name: Nuzzle
short_description: 100% chance to paralyze the target.
long_description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

name: Solar Beam
short_description: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
long_description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.

name: Spotlight
short_description: Target's foes' moves are redirected to it this turn.
long_description: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from opponents of the target are redirected to the target. Such attacks are redirected to the target before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal.

name: Baddy Bad
short_description: Summons Reflect.
long_description: This move summons Reflect for 5 turns upon use.

name: Ingrain
short_description: Traps/grounds user; heals 1/16 max HP per turn.
long_description: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

name: Covet
short_description: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.
long_description: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Z-Crystal, or if the target is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, or a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

name: G-Max Befuddle
short_description: Base move affects power. Foes: slp or psn or par.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side either falls asleep, becomes poisoned, or becomes paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

name: Sandsear Storm
short_description: 20% chance to burn foe(s). Can't miss in rain.
long_description: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

name: Screech
short_description: Lowers the target's Defense by 2.
long_description: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.

name: Power Trick
short_description: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.
long_description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

name: Encore
short_description: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.
long_description: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

name: Thunder Punch
short_description: 10% chance to paralyze the target.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

name: Shadow Ball
short_description: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
long_description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

name: Noxious Torque
short_description: 30% chance to poison the target.
long_description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

name: Pluck
short_description: User steals and eats the target's Berry.
long_description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

name: G-Max One Blow
short_description: Base move affects power. Bypasses Max Guard.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move bypasses all protection effects, including Max Guard.

name: Behemoth Bash
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Branch Poke
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Nightmare
short_description: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.
long_description: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.

name: Belch
short_description: Cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry.
long_description: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.

name: Bind
short_description: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
long_description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

name: Zen Headbutt
short_description: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
long_description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

name: Slam
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Mist
short_description: For 5 turns, protects user's party from stat drops.
long_description: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

name: Max Flare
short_description: Base move affects power. Starts Sunny Day.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Sunny Day begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.

name: Sludge
short_description: 30% chance to poison the target.
long_description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

name: Fire Lash
short_description: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
long_description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

name: Steamroller
short_description: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
long_description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

name: Spiky Shield
short_description: Protects from moves. Contact: loses 1/8 max HP.
long_description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

name: G-Max Wind Rage
short_description: Base move affects power. Ends Terrain, hazards.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain end, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side.

name: Aqua Jet
short_description: Usually goes first.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Kowtow Cleave
short_description: This move does not check accuracy.
long_description: This move does not check accuracy.

name: Curse
short_description: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.
long_description: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

name: Growth
short_description: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.
long_description: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land.

name: Core Enforcer
short_description: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.
long_description: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

name: Water Spout
short_description: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
long_description: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

name: Flash
short_description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1.
long_description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

name: Bonemerang
short_description: Hits 2 times in one turn.
long_description: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

name: Head Smash
short_description: Has 1/2 recoil.
long_description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

name: Inferno
short_description: 100% chance to burn the target.

long_description: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.

name: Skill Swap
short_description: The user and the target trade Abilities.
long_description: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

name: Double Team
short_description: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1.
long_description: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

name: Water Gun
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Mud Sport
short_description: For 5 turns, Electric-type attacks have 1/3 power.
long_description: For 5 turns, all Electric-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.

name: Embargo
short_description: For 5 turns, the target's item has no effect.
long_description: For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.

name: Snowscape
short_description: For 5 turns, snow falls. Ice: 1.5x Def.
long_description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.

name: Feint Attack
short_description: This move does not check accuracy.
long_description: This move does not check accuracy.

name: Guardian of Alola
short_description: Does damage equal to 3/4 target's current HP.
long_description: Deals damage to the target equal to 3/4 of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

name: Flame Wheel
short_description: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

name: Corkscrew Crash
short_description: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

name: Fly
short_description: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.
long_description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

name: Thunderclap
short_description: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.
long_description: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

name: Oblivion Wing
short_description: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.
long_description: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

name: Thunder Cage
short_description: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
long_description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

name: Cross Chop
short_description: High critical hit ratio.
long_description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

name: Synchronoise
short_description: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.
long_description: The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.

name: Dazzling Gleam
short_description: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Steel Roller
short_description: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the terrain.
long_description: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

name: Heal Pulse
short_description: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
long_description: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

name: Decorate
short_description: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.
long_description: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

name: Astral Barrage
short_description: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Fickle Beam
short_description: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.
long_description: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

name: Bone Club
short_description: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

name: Power Shift
short_description: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.
long_description: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

name: Strength Sap
short_description: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.
long_description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

name: Counter
short_description: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.
long_description: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

name: Bug Bite
short_description: User steals and eats the target's Berry.
long_description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

name: G-Max Stonesurge
short_description: Base move affects power. Foes: Stealth Rock.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

name: Catastropika
short_description: No additional effect.
long_description: No additional effect.

name: Aqua Cutter
short_description: High critical hit ratio.
long_description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

name: Psychic Terrain
short_description: 5 turns. Grounded: +Psychic power, priority-safe.
long_description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

name: Bubble Beam
short_description: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
long_description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

name: Psycho Boost
short_description: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
long_description: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

name: Revelation Dance
short_description: Type varies based on the user's primary type.
long_description: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.

name: Swallow
short_description: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.
long_description: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

name: Barrier
short_description: Raises the user's Defense by 2.
long_description: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

name: Block
short_description: Prevents the target from switching out.
long_description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

name: Max Starfall
short_description: Base move affects power. Starts Misty Terrain.
long_description: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Misty Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.

name: Leaf Tornado
short_description: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
long_description: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

name: Bide
short_description: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.
long_description: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.
